title: vinca herbacea subsp. libanotica
intro: Vinca herbacea subsp. libanotica, commonly known as Levant periwinkle, is a subspecies of the Vinca herbacea plant, which is a type of flowering plant in the Apocynaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, including the treatment of various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Levant periwinkle include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids like vincamine and ajmalicine. These constituents may also contribute to the plant's ability to improve cardiovascular health, reduce stress, and promote relaxation.
